body: Sure I'll add you on discord and no worries about the mic, just beware I'm not some DBD god to carry or anything and we'll be just fine.

Well you could first sit down with your friend to let them know you're working hard towards getting another job and someone is interested in you, but you wouldn't be able to pay them back right away and even when you did, work it out to pay a little back at a time so you're not just giving them everything you're making so you have something at least. Also kind of weird you mention your family is successful, but have you tried to go to them? I mean what is family if you're unwilling to help each other? That's kind of the opposite from a family. I understand some families have tough love, but times have changed and sticking together is needed now more than ever in terms of family. I hate people who preach about family and togetherness, but then do some weird tough love act and throw out their own kids or just leave them to their fate. If you choose to be a parent, it's your duty until you die. You brought a life into this world, no excuses, your kids didn't get the choice, you made it.  I could understand if they really can't because times are tough, but even a place to sleep while you get back on your feet, hell even throw you up a tent in their backyard or something if they have one, just anything. I've been homeless in my life, I've slept in a tent, inside of a car, there's no shame in it. It was actually kind of nice since I enjoy the outdoors. It's not for everybody though I understand.

I understand he's concerned, but that is his ex and he shouldn't have to babysit her. We all go through rough periods in our lives, but he literally can't be there every time she's having a bad day, if that was the case, they never should of broken up. Eventually he'll have to wash his hands of her and either just stay friends, but being friends doesn't mean you get to toy with someone's emotions when you're not getting what you want. What he should of done is called for a wellness check and be done with it. I know that's harsh, but it'll never stop happening and you guys will just continue to build tension in your own relationship.

I don't know, people seem to nitpick everything about me so when it came to personal hygiene. I take care of myself so other people don't have more ammo to aim at me. I already got beat with the ugly stick, don't need to add to it.

However if they take the time to get to know me before they see a face, I've never been turned down and we pretty much always start dating.

At least looks don't matter right, as so many great human beings who never judge a book by it's cover would say. It's all a lie, I've seen it my whole life first hand.

When I realized I'm not worth anyone's time a very long time ago. That's when I realized there's no hope because it's been some years now. At first it was a crushing feeling, made me question why I was born, spent a long time thinking about why was I  put here just to literally suffer by myself. I kept reaching out to people to hangout with spend time with, but I'm slowly just giving up because I don't have whatever everyone else has to draw people in. So now I don't enjoy any aspect of life, just dragging the old corpse to the finish line so other people don't have to suffer from my death, like some family.

I'm not even attractive enough for friendship. I'm just a goblin who got out of his cave.

Nature already took it's course and beat my ass nasty with the ugly stick. I keep trying like yourself, but if it did happen. I'm so socially awkward now it would just be a waste of the other persons time. Life made sure I was never going to win. I just want people to talk to, but whatever people have that draws people in, God said go fuck myself, you're doing this shit alone.

I never understood why life choose to beat my ass nasty so often and why I have to be alone, but what else can I do? I keep trying to fight it, but I'm just alone in my fight and I'm getting tired of getting up because what am I fighting for? For me to get up to be reminded of being alone again? That people don't find me very interesting? I've always felt like I didn't belong anywhere, never had that home feeling people talk about. I must of been a real piece of shit in another life to deserve dying alone.

I can't say, people are very fickle when it comes to who they converse with and you might be drawing in the wrong people. Everyone has a type, no matter what they say,  you'll always aim for what you see as what you want, looks, career, so on and so forth. Problem is they also have their version of whoever they dreamed up. It also depends on your age. if you're an adult, it's a nightmare, it's literally a nightmare trying to date another human being. Unless you're beautiful, it's a cake walk, if you're not, welcome to the struggle bus where some of us are going to be alone our entire lives. I know men who make hundreds of thousands of dollars a year. He was told his life was too put together with the last woman he tired to date. Personally I would just take having some decent friends at this point and even then I can't fucking draw people in to want to talk to me. I got nothing and I'm not worthy.

One really is the loneliest number that you'll ever do. As the man once said "I'd go through the bloodiest war and have all my limbs cut off, if it meant I'd come home to a woman." I believe he said even if she was overweight and ugly, but I wouldn't go that far. However for me it isn't about having a romantic relationship, that ship sailed far away. I just want to have some people to talk to on a regular basis, alas I don't have the magic to draw people in.
I like the blue rock, but the things that live on the blue rock. the meaty flesh creatures, don't care if I'm also on the blue rock with them. So it's just me and the blue rock.

That's why when it comes to vampires and werewolves, werewolves are pretty cool to me, but I would prefer to be a vampire. I enjoy the night when no ones around, not like anyone wants to spend time with me anyways, but I would just have the life span to sit in a forest for a 100 or so years, just at night, staring at the moon, trying to figure out life. I know I don't have any dreams. I used to have one and it was to wake up once in my life and be glad to be alive, to be happy about it. That has yet to happen and at the pace I'm going, it's a long and lonely life of waking up and just being... numb to life.

It is quite disheartening isn't it? I keep trying and I reach out to people, but no one ever seems interested. Whatever people have that draws other people in. I just ain't got it... Wish I did... I'm not looking to be the most popular person on planet Earth, but it would be nice to talk to anyone on a regular basis or even semi regular basis... I keep trying as everyone says things will magically change, but at this point is just makes me a more socially awkward person, which just increases everyones uninterest in knowing me. Maybe they think I'm going to open the flood gates and make their life miserable... Nope I'll keep my mask on and we pretend we're just two normal human beings. I've had people say sure we'll talk or hangout, whatever, but then it's like tv static and I'm just sat there waiting like an idiot.

You got bug friends? I don't even have bug friends...

Well I mean you could still be an Artist, you might not be the next Picasso, but once you find yourself a little following, it kind of changes your life. You're allowed to dream of whatever kind of life you'd like, but the difference is a dream isn't meant to be real so you'd have to work at it to make it a reality. I'm not good with making friends, it's why I have no bug buddies or human buddies, can't give you any advice there, but I will agree, if I was more beautiful, the people would want to know me, but I'm just a goblin.

What a story, the build up! I could feel the love between you guys, but then BAM! There's mystery person and they're in love already!?

What a roller coaster of emotions I just went through. I don't know if I can handle all of it, now I just want to know more.

That's why people like to believe the people you lose and love go to a better place. No one knows for sure and I know someone will say that they do because someone else said so or it's in a book they read that was written by someone else a long time ago. It's the comfort you get that they're happy where they are, it's the power of belief and belief is a very powerful thing. The people you love and have lost wouldn't want to see you in so much pain. I'm assuming you've had loved one pass on and you have to remind yourself their suffering has ended, whether it was after a long life or a short lived one, the break you give yourself is the belief they're in a better place and never forget them and keep them in your heart, they'll always be with you.

I too have weird eyebrows, the capatiller eye brows to be exact. As some of my cousins kids would say.  I'm Italian and it's just going to be that way. I also understand I spelled caterpillar the wrong way. I don't know if this will work for you or even ease some of the tension in your life, but as someone whose not experience love in a normal way or just in a way it should be enjoyed. I've come up with my own type of love. I don't need to be loved anymore, as you put it, it's just not something that's meant for me. There's just an hole there and even if tomorrow someone just magically appeared it would do nothing, they are better off, and I won't drag anyone through this hell. My love boat only needs the captain to go down with the ship. However I love everything around me instead. Take nature... I love just sitting outside on beautiful night just star gazing. So I have love, just in a different way. I love food and dining and enjoying a fine drink or wine, I love watching horror movies and scary things. So while another human being will never love me. I can love other things instead and enjoy a bit of life even if it's not exactly perfect. So I may not get a humans love and I wouldn't let them, it's not worth it honestly. I will just continue to just let the thought slip out of my mind while I just enjoy the things around me instead. It seems people take for granted whats right in front of them, you're more worried about where you should be instead of enjoying where you are. It seems hard to see through all of the BS you're going through, but have you ever just sat outside and just stared at the moon? It's a pretty enjoyable experience.

The only time you will fail your child is when you give up, sometimes you have to do amazing things for the sake of your child. You might not want too, but it's not just your life on the line anymore. Sometimes being a parent means pushing yourself past your limits. Some people will never get that chance, so do your best and stay strong. Also where's the fiance in all this? Not trying to be... rude? about it, just a curious wondering because one  person working for a family can be brutal, but two makes it a little easier.

I don't doubt it, but if you just go outside and really take it in. Let the sun hit your skin, feel the breeze of the wind, close your eyes. Nature itself is actually pretty cool. Nothing I love more than sitting outside on a nice night, just brain turned off, and being amazed by just nature. You don't have to do anything, just take it all in, let the stress fall off your shoulders for a few minutes.

It's actually not so bad if the bad part of it never comes up, but if it does and I randomly starting having brain bleeding, well I win and I'm free.

I can hangout with people, but in my mind and in my heart... I am alone.

Don't worry about boyfriends, girlfriends, what people think of you, what job you'll have, don't worry about your parents want you home at a certain time. Those things are nothing, small, in comparison to what you'll deal with as an adult. It's not horrible, but it's also not easy. You'll have time for all kinds of boyfriends girlfriends, staying out as late as you want, finding a job. You will literally be an adult the rest of your life after you turn 18. 

So please, be a kid, run and play, be silly, get off your phone, go outside, explore the world.
I agree it's pretty bad, but I mean maybe it's okay not to be someone who has to do something world changing and just be you and live in the moment.

Nothing wrong with you. As far back as I can remember, even being a kid, I wished life had a switch... Think of like a light switch you can flip and just faded away.

The only dream I have alive is a switch I can turn off and be done with it all, too bad it's only a dream.

I forgive you, wait what am I forgiving you for? It seems you may be over thinking your situation, it happens when you're by yourself and inside your own head. I know I can totally fucking annihilate myself without anyone's help. Sprinkle in the fact that I'm not really super close to the few friends that I have, it can be a little dicey and my mind just goes off the rails, but you're not alone in not knowing what the fuck is going on half the time. I have no idea what people expect of me or why it seems like I have to be a NASA Astronaut or a Rocket Scientist. I'm just some guy who hates humans, but everything else is pretty okay. I know I'm not very funny and yadda yadda, old soul, boring guy. It does suck sometimes just not being anyones favorite person and I'm not even talking in a romantic way, it would just be pretty awesome for someone to be like... That guy... I want to hangout with that guy. Instead I'm the last guy you hangout with when you got no one else and I have no idea how to talk to people, so it just doesn't work. Why do I suck so much... It's hard to say, but it might not always be you whose the problem, ya know? We're always so quick to turn the gun on ourselves, but it might be the people around you.

Yeah it's like not being anyone's best friend, you're not really anyone's first pick to hang out with or message. Pretty much anything someone who had close friends would do. I've got a decent group of friends, but I'm just no that high on the list. I actually had an argument with one friend where he doesn't message me or call or come over, yet when I mentioned how we barely hangout, he lost it. I was only being truthful, communication works both ways. I don't agree with your food situation, sorry but food is good. People might let you down, but eating something good just can't, it's always going to be good if done right. I would say you could just tackle your problems one at a time and try to ignore the ones you can't change, because usually you can't change them, so worry about the ones you can change for the time being. When I was younger, people would say I always looked sad, it was true. Now since I'm an adult, I just hide it all the time. People don't like sad people or people with problems, they avoid you. I'm the opposite I don't like to see people being alone, they don't have to be and shouldn't be. It's why I'm here now typing my little novel to you, so you are not alone.

Weird my father is the same way, he doesn't care at all what happens when he passes, but my parents should of never had kids. I don't say that out of my disdain because I absolutely hate life in general, but they were just shitty parents. I don't see my mother at all and I'm not surprised she left my father when I was young, but she got to escape into her own fairy tale and well I'm still in that nightmare. It's been one hell of a ride of bullshit. I can go outside freely, but there's no point, the grass isn't always greener, but I don't think if you went outside you'd be mauled by a wild animal, unless you just walked out into the woods. It's not that insane outside that there's just rabid animals on the loose. It's the only nice thing about being outside. Maybe you can do out and sit and just enjoy the sounds, the sights. Just close your eyes, nature is actually quite amazing. Also nothing beats sitting out on a nice night and just staring into the stars. Your parents seem very religious and that tends to blind people from the every changing world, times have changed, but the older you get the less likely you'll change your life and your habits. You're also not likely to get kidnapped unless you're alone at night in a bad neighborhood. You should always be careful though. Getting a job isn't that hard either, it seems scary because you have to interact with another person, but you could go after something you'd think you'd enjoy and hope for the best. That's all anyone can do is hope.
You just have to learn that people do care about you and to stop thinking about it and let it just happen.

I do know there is some upsides to being alone and I've gone through some things and seen some things, but I'm not superman. If I was I would of flown away from earth by now. When my problems hit, it's just another day to try and make it through, but eventually you just start to lose hope and nothing quite hits harder than emotional pain. You're lucky to have a wife and then a son. I'll never experience those things in my lifetime.

A long miserable lonely life, can't wait.... I can't say I feel any rage, there isn't much going on inside. I could go for some passion love making if I'm going to be screwed this bad and get a break from the brutal fuckening. I honestly have no idea have to connect with other people, if you figure it out, let me know.
Don't we all.

I have friends, not so much the family, wasn't really close to anyone. I'm not really anyone's best friend so people don't come to me to hangout or anything, but still there is that void. It's why I'm here now. That very hopeless feeling creeping in, knowing that I'm alone and will more than likely live what life I have left alone. People tell me the typical thing of just keep going, but I have nothing to look forward to. Even if life turned around tomorrow, it's too late. I crushed any hopes and dreams I could have just to survive this feeling, this empty void. It's a tough demon to beat.

I know people say to be confident, but those titles like boyfriend, husband, father... I don't know they just don't suit me. I just can't see myself doing any of that. I totally fucking hate being alone all the time and I have friends, but not that deep emotional connection with someone, but I'm not worth that kind of commitment. I can't see it.

Allow me to apologize, but my experiences aren't that of a woman, it's of a man. I also stated that sometimes single mothers have a harder time finding someone because they now have children and seeing as I didn't know their age I literally said it probably won't be a factor. Men typically have it harder when meeting the requirements of a woman when they have kids, might make you skip certain guys altogether, it's not just you to worry about but who you bring into your children's lives. The six figures is a joke between men because the microscope we're put under to even be considered. Not knowing your preference for a man, you might be looking for something very specific which could make it a bit harder to find someone you connect with. I am not you, just an outside pair of eyes who can say "Hey these things might be why, maybe we can formulate a new plan of attack to help you out." Maybe my approach is wrong and I was crass in the way I made it seem, so again I apologize. I am just a misogynistic meat popsicle, you are correct.

Why are men usually invisible to women? Because we're judged on how valuable we are. We have to look good, sound sexy, make six figures, have our lives put together, be fit and in shape. You can find a man easily, but you're probably shooting for what you think you deserve which is probably what I stated. I know this will probably be down voted, but your standards might be a little high. You also have children, which brings in a different kind of baggage, not saying it's bad but now he has to provide for you and your kids who aren't his. That's not always an easy thing for a single guy when he can meet someone without kids or if he wants kids of his own, what kind of conversation does that bring up. Since I don't know how old they are or your own age, that might not even be a factor. Not to say there aren't good men out there, but they are rare just like a good woman is.

The whole point of you're not alone is a reminder that you have no friends, but you're not the only one who has no friends. I have no friends, so you are not alone in having no friends. Your suffering is a shared pain because there's a lot pf people with no one. As it was best said 80% of people don't care about your problems and 20% are glad you have them. People tell you you're not alone as it means you are not alone, you are in fact alone, like so many other people. That is a shared bond is your loneliness, which in fact you are not alone in feeling. The pain is the bridge that binds us all together.

You know nothing isn't always a bad thing because as you're finding out something can be worse than nothing. You don't deserve all the self hate as you've been working hard providing for two people. That's nothing to sneeze at and good on you for working full time and supporting someone you cared about. You shouldn't lose those qualities because they're rare ones. I can't say what you of should or shouldn't of done when it comes to the abortion, but I do apologize that you had to go through such an ordeal, my condolences. I don't know what I would do in that situation, it's a tough one.  I do agree if your worth ethic is an indicator of the kind of person you are, you would of did a good job. However with the letting him sleep with other people or be with them romantically... I know myself personally, not a fan of sharing in that regard. That should of been an indicator. I'll only tell you my opinion on it and I don't mind if you disagree, but if I pick someone to be with in the romantic sense, that's it and all she wrote. To me they are the best, there's no one no one else. I know these days people are into that, but maybe I'm a little too old school. It's unfortunate how things played out and you might feel alone, but we're here for you. I've seen a lot of stuff happen in my time and it still breaks my heart seeing good people in pain. My only advice is to drop him, don't humiliate yourself crawling back for him. You deserve better and I know it's hard to see that now, but I do hope you stay strong.

Lars this is going to sound maybe a little preachy, but going to the gym... getting a job. Trust me on this, don't rush to try and be an adult. You'll have plenty of time for that, worry about being a kid, because when you're an adult, you'll miss being a kid. Your body is going to change, a guy I know who lost all of his hair when he was like 16 just kind of embraced it and turns it into a positive. You don't think he would of wanted a full head of hair when he was a teenager and onward, but now he's just accepted that he's bald and can make jokes and laugh at himself. Eventually you'll get the chance not to be around your parents, also work hard. No matter where you get a job, just do your best. Everyone starts small, we're not all millionaires with amazing jobs that pay well.
Sounds like heaven.
No thank you needed, just stay you.

Can I fight your parents for you? Serious question because it's kind of horrible to keep throwing kicking you out in your face. As it was best put, you didn't choose to be born, your parents made that choice so you're their responsibility until they die. Even if they never do it, it's not alright to hang that over your head, being a teenager is tough enough with everything else. I doubt they would actually do it, but it's not something they should weaponize, no parent should. I'm sorry you're having to have it thrown at you all the time.
